sections.Profile:
"Challenge Round" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Hispamatic, S.A., a Spanish manufacturer based in Badalona, in the 1970s. The game features a tennis theme, incorporating two flippers, three pop bumpers, and two slingshots

- Manufacturer: Hispamatic
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Sports, Original Theme, Tennis, 1970s
